_readme: Hand-checked Christmas details, keyed by pub slug (the slug in /pubs/<slug>). Every field is optional. Anything here overrides what scripts/christmas-scan.mjs found on the pub's website, and only facts in this file (menu and booking links, capacities, Christmas Day opening) are ever stated on the site. Set verified_date (YYYY-MM-DD) to the day you checked; pages then say 'Confirmed by the pub on <date>'. Set a flag to false to keep a pub off a page. Copy the _example block, rename it to the slug, and delete the fields you don't need. The 'market' block powers /christmas/brighton-christmas-market: add the official page as source_url, and lat/lng (decimal degrees) to switch on the 'pubs near the market' list. Market name, dates and location text are shown only when source_url is set.
